---
title: "Teste poisson e NB bivariado"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  rmdformats::downcute:
    self_contained: true
    code_folding: hide
    default_style: "light"
    downcute_theme: "default"
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = T, warning = F, message = F)

library(INLA)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(nowcaster)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(scoringutils)

# Funções multivar nowcasting
source("functions_multivar_nowcasting.R")
```


```{r}
## Leitura e preparação de dados para o modelo
dados <- readRDS("Dados\\den_chik_2017_2019_RJ.RData")
dados <- dados %>% janitor::clean_names()

dados |>
  filter(dt_sin_pri > ymd("2017-01-01")) |>
  select(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, arbo) |> 
  create_data(D = 15) |> 
  model_data(max_year = 2019, max_epiweek = 20) -> data_model

data_real <- dados |>
  filter(dt_sin_pri > ymd("2017-01-01")) |>
  select(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, arbo) |> 
  create_data(D = 15, return_data_real = T)


```

## RW(1) para delay e RW(2) para tempo

```{r}
## Modelo bivariado - binomial negativa
inla_run_nb   <- run_inla_model(data_model, family = "nbinomial")
output_nb     <- inla_run_nb$inla_output
joint_data_nb <- inla_run_nb$joint_data

test_sample_predictive_nb <- sample_predictive(inla_output = output_nb, 
                                               joint_data = joint_data_nb)

total_summary_nb <- bivar_nowcasting_summary(test_sample_predictive_nb)


## Modelo bivariado - Poisson
inla_run_pois  <- run_inla_model(data_model, family = "poisson")
output_pois     <- inla_run_pois$inla_output
joint_data_pois <- inla_run_pois$joint_data

test_sample_predictive_pois <- sample_predictive(inla_output = output_pois, 
                                                 joint_data = joint_data_pois,
                                                 family = "poisson")

total_summary_pois <- bivar_nowcasting_summary(test_sample_predictive_pois)

```



```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
data_real %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(year < 2019 | epiweek <= 20) %>% 
  mutate(time = rep(unique(data_model$time), each = 2)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "arbo", values_from = "y") %>% 
  rename(y1 = Chik, y2 = Den) -> data_real

## Gráficos correção - Binomial negativa
total_summary_nb |> 
  left_join(data_real, by = "time") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Median_y1, col = 'Nowcasting')) +
  geom_line(data = data_real %>% filter(time > 100), 
            aes(date, y = y1, col = 'Observed')) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LI_y1, ymax = LS_y1, col = NA), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = F) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Chikungunya - Negative Binomial") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('grey50', 'black'), name = '')+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = '2 weeks', date_labels = '%V/%y', name = 'Date in Weeks')+
  labs(x = '', y = 'Nº Cases') -> chik_correct_nb

total_summary_nb |> 
  left_join(data_real, by = "time") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Median_y2, col = 'Nowcasting')) +
  geom_line(data = data_real %>% filter(time > 100), 
            aes(date, y = y2, col = 'Observed')) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LI_y2, ymax = LS_y2, col = NA), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = F) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Dengue - Negative Binomial") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('grey50', 'black'), name = '')+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = '2 weeks', date_labels = '%V/%y', name = 'Date in Weeks')+
  labs(x = '', y = 'Nº Cases') -> dengue_correct_nb

# Gráficos correção - Poisson
total_summary_pois |> 
  left_join(data_real, by = "time") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Median_y1, col = 'Nowcasting')) +
  geom_line(data = data_real %>% filter(time > 100), 
            aes(date, y = y1, col = 'Observed')) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LI_y1, ymax = LS_y1, col = NA), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = F) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Chikungunya - Poisson") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('grey50', 'black'), name = '')+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = '2 weeks', date_labels = '%V/%y', name = 'Date in Weeks')+
  labs(x = '', y = 'Nº Cases') -> chik_correct_pois

total_summary_pois |> 
  left_join(data_real, by = "time") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Median_y2, col = 'Nowcasting')) +
  geom_line(data = data_real %>% filter(time > 100), 
            aes(date, y = y2, col = 'Observed')) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LI_y2, ymax = LS_y2, col = NA), alpha = 0.2, show.legend = F) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Dengue - Poisson") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('grey50', 'black'), name = '')+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = '2 weeks', date_labels = '%V/%y', name = 'Date in Weeks')+
  labs(x = '', y = 'Nº Cases') -> dengue_correct_pois

(chik_correct_nb + dengue_correct_nb) / (chik_correct_pois + dengue_correct_pois)

```

```{r}
## data_real para entrar na função de energy e variogram score
data_real <- data_real |> select(time, y1,y2)
scores_nb <- scores_posterior(test_sample_predictive_nb, data_real)
scores_pois <- scores_posterior(test_sample_predictive_pois, data_real)

energy_score_nb <- scores_nb$energy_score
energy_score_pois <- scores_pois$energy_score

variogram_score_nb <- scores_nb$variogram_score
variogram_score_pois <- scores_pois$variogram_score
```

```{r}
ts.plot(energy_score_pois, main = "Energy score")
lines(energy_score_nb, col = 2)
legend("topleft", col = c(1,2), lty = 1, legend = c("Poisson", "Negative Binomial"))

ts.plot(variogram_score_pois, main = "Variogram score")
lines(variogram_score_nb, col = 2)
legend("topleft", col = c(1,2), lty = 1, legend = c("Poisson", "Negative Binomial"))
```

### Métricas 
```{r}
### colocar metricas 
rbind("NB" = selection_criteria(total_summary_nb, data_real,
                         inla_run_nb$inla_output),
      "Poisson" = selection_criteria(total_summary_pois, data_real,
                         inla_run_pois$inla_output)) |> 
  knitr::kable() |> 
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
```
